criteria.text: A current v2 machine proof for the same run and freshly computed merge-base/current committed head appears as a successful "Old-code proof:" line naming the exact command, old/new exits and expected output text in safe code spans.

A current unsuccessful proof remains visible with its actual outcome, observed/host cause and short actual output tail when available; parent interruption is distinct from child signals even before or between phases, setup/cleanup errors retain priority, and proof is not a publication gate.

An older committed head or computed base is "stale"; missing proof is "not run"; legacy v1, malformed (including a missing required parent-interruption field) or foreign-run proof is "unavailable". The immutable saved run base is not the current proof comparison base.
An agent-written "Old-code proof:" line cannot replace missing machine evidence, and the prompt-space PR carries no machine proof line.
